review.purpose: Check funding-history capability before interpreting availability.
review.finding: Two of three selected fixture venues support funding history, one contributes rows in the window. Unsupported Kraken is not called; supported-empty OKX is distinct from a measured zero funding rate.

review.purpose: Retain the original multi-page settlement history, infer intervals and compare fixed-denominator simple annualization.
review.finding: 42 settlements span an 8→4-hour interval transition. All 41 preceding gaps agree with inferred intervals. Fixed 8h changes 20 conversions by up to 43.8 percentage points/year; 4h moves error to the 17 nonzero 8h settlements with unchanged source fingerprint.

review.purpose: Establish the fixture exchange roster and capability population before selecting contracts and fan-outs.
review.finding: Four explicit stand-in identities are shown; only two support funding history and open interest. Capability support, selected contract existence and successful snapshot returns are separate populations, not an implied list of live exchanges.

review.purpose: Read contract size, base/quote/settle and linear/inverse fields before making a quantity conversion.
review.finding: The selected BTC perpetual definitions share the symbol but differ in contract size (1 versus 0.01). Explicitly assuming the open-interest amount is contracts gives a 100× mismatch for the OKX stand-in against its reported value; the synthetic generator explains this, not a proven live conversion.

review.purpose: Use the reported last quote as a clearly identified reference price, retaining unavailable fan-out rows.
review.finding: Two perpetual tickers supply reference prices for an explicit unit test; Kraken retains an error and NULL measurements. The separately retrieved Binance spot ticker agrees with book level 1. Shared fixture timestamps do not establish atomic real snapshots.

review.purpose: Distinguish upcoming synthetic settlement funding and its own interval from the historical settlement schedule.
review.finding: Both successful rows report 1 bp per eight-hour interval and 10.95% simple annualization; Kraken is unavailable. The fixture current generator retains eight hours independently of the history generator transition, so current interval is not substituted for historical intervals.

review.purpose: Compare reported open-interest value against an explicit, testable contracts-unit assumption.
review.finding: Raw amount is 12,345 on both stand-ins; reported values near 494 million USDT do not automatically imply matching contract counts. The 0.01 contract-size assumption yields 4.94 million for OKX versus 494.05 million reported. The mismatch remains visible and prevents unsupported aggregation.

review.purpose: Cumulatively aggregate explicitly spot BTC quantities and compare level-one prices with a separate ticker.
review.finding: Five levels per side return 15 BTC each; ten levels return 55 BTC with original rows retained and other measurements identical. Price distance is measured in basis points from the spot midpoint; no execution or liquidity guarantee is inferred.

review.purpose: Measure a cap-limited candle prefix against a known fixed-hour fixture population.
review.finding: A 40-row budget returns 40 of 60 minute candles through timestamp 00:39. At 80, all 60 candle labels through 00:59 are returned; earlier rows remain identical. Labels and continuous interval coverage are explicitly distinguished.

review.purpose: Keep unique event IDs across timestamp ties and page boundaries while measuring the temporal effect of an output cap.
review.finding: 40 trades occupy 21 timestamps through 00:20, ending with one of three expected events at that minute. At 80, more than one 40-trade page is needed; the prior event IDs remain identical and the final timestamp still has a partial group. Timestamp-only deduplication would discard valid synthetic events.
